name: Landgasthof-Pension Ledererwirt
beschreibung: The Landgasthof-Pension Ledererwirt is located in the municipality of Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterinntal, near the German border. The surroundings are characterized by the mountain backdrop of the Kaisergebirges and are ideal for hikes and ski tours. The inn offers rooms in traditional style as well as a dining room with regional cuisine and a tiled stove. The amenities include a sun terrace and free parking. The atmosphere is down-to-earth and family-like, characterized by Tiroler hospitality. The target group primarily includes active holidaymakers seeking nature and quiet, as well as lovers of homemade specialties.
